property.name: recordIds

property.name: recordNames
property.label: Record Names
property.description: Display labels for selected records, in the same order as Record Ids

property.label: Object API Name
property.description: API name of the SObject to create (e.g. Contract_Bid__c)

property.name: fieldNames
property.label: Field Names Override

property.label: Layout Type

property.description: Deprecated: no longer used, kept for Flow compatibility

property.name: recordTypeId
property.label: Record Type Id
property.description: Optional record type for layout and create form

property.name: formFieldNames
property.label: Resolved Form Field Names
property.description: All field API names rendered in the form

property.name: clonePayloadJson
property.label: Clone Payload JSON
property.description: JSON payloads for all records, prepared when the user clicks Review

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card Title
property.description: Title shown on the selected records card

property.name: iconName
